added.summary: A range input with `low` and `high` is a range slider: two knobs on one track and the fill between them, each its own focus stop, a press taking the nearer knob, and CSS `-og-min-gap` keeping them apart; both values are written back. The document form of the rangeSlider builder (docs/ui.md §2).

A text input's `list` names a `<datalist>` whose options, or whose bound `items={$names}`, are suggestions listed under the field while it has the focus, filtered by its text with prefix matches first; choosing one writes it to the field. The document form of the searchBox builder (docs/ui.md §2).
